scope: Same fixed convex phone, COM/inertia assumptions and no-hand tests; refine only the nominal timestep ladder. No physics is performed by this protocol author.

frozen_references.rule: Resolve the exact pinned v2 file; do not use defaults or read an unfrozen replacement. OriginalG3-G8 bounds remain unchanged, including2mm peak penetration and2deg final timestep orientation difference.

tests.initial_hull_support_rule: Exact same common4460 compiled-hull vertex support/Rx90/COM-offset initialization; save support operands. Never replace hull support by assumed box thickness.

screening.order: dt as listed, then three tests as listed
screening.pair_comparison_rule: Only these adjacent coarse/fine pairs enter selection. At shared ticks compare coarse i with fine2i, for all three tests. Save all six comparisons. The shared middle-dt data are reused, not independent replicates.

selection.screening_complete_rule: All9 exact original case IDs/pins, steps, source/model binding, supported diagnostics and saved arithmetic are fully assessed. Completeness is not physical acceptance.
selection.pair_eligible_rule: For the six runs in an adjacent pair, every test at both dt passes originalG2-G6, and all three corresponding originalG7 comparisons pass. Source/input integrity, all9coverage and the pinned finite-sampling geometry qualification must hold. Unknown is not eligible.
selection.choice_rule: Among eligible adjacent pairs select the one with largest coarse_dt, in the fixed listed pair order. Do not minimize a metric, select individual tests, change tau, or discard a run.
selection.none_rule: If none eligible, selected_timesteps_s=null and no v3confirmation/Warp. Preserve all failures. A further grid or model change requires a new protocol.

confirmation.order: nominal(.2,.6)first; remaining(mass,mu)lexicographic; dt ordered coarse then fine; tests as listed
confirmation.interpretation: Same-family engineering parameter-range confirmation, not blind independent scientific confirmation, independent trajectories or real parameter calibration.

output_ABI.trajectory_pins: Map all9 exact case IDs to original immutable raw pins; confirmation map all54.
output_ABI.selected_values: selected_timeconst_s is always.0025. selected_timesteps_s is one exact pair from screening.adjacent_pairs_s ornull; screening_complete/selection_complete separate coverage from completed selection arithmetic.
output_ABI.all_data_preserved: All9screen cases, all6pair comparisons, allfailed/unknown physical gates, and the source diagnostic availability are retained. No positive-case-only report.

execution_binding.before_integration: Pin this protocol, exact references, common4460/run_case1b688, new thin runner source, asset/hull/visual/models_info, complete process logs and stage inputs; save actual compiled/device options, raw support/COM/inertia, raw state/contact/force/energy/diagnostics as in v2.
execution_binding.later_phases: New54CPU and Warp bind the exact selection SHA and selected pair; Warp additionally binds complete CPU54assessment and map54raw pins. No null selection authorizes --run.
execution_binding.effective_options: CPUtol1e-6/ls_tol.01 and actual GPUFP32 representations must be read/validated before first integration; keep all supported overflow diagnostics and do not invent a native GPUwarning table.

scope_limits.known_prior_failure: v2tau.0025 push final orientation differed4.391561deg across its two coarser dt; that known failure motivated this new fixed ladder.
